materials.name: Steel
materials.blurb: Scrap that has been told what it is for. Four scrap in, one bar out, and the bar is straight.

materials.name: Alloy
materials.blurb: Steel married to titanium in a very hot room. Lighter than it looks and prouder than it should be.

materials.name: Conductor
materials.blurb: Copper drawn fine and doped with silicon. Carries a reactor's mood to the far end of the ship.

materials.name: Glass Lattice
materials.blurb: Silicon and crystal spun into a net that bends light the way you ask. Cold to the touch, and it hums.
